description: The pie chart represents a breakdown of total time cost into two categories related to optimized deployment strategies, showing 2 slices in total. One slice is labeled “Efficient deployment,” colored blue, and is annotated inside the slice as 26.2s (30.08%). The other slice is labeled “Reduction,” colored orange, and is annotated as 60.9s (69.92%). Both slices display percentage and time-value labels within the segments, and there is no separate legend visible; the blue “Efficient deployment” slice is visually emphasized by being slightly exploded/offset from the rest of the pie.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the impact of optimized deployment strategies on time efficiency, revealing a substantial but uneven reduction in temporal expenditure. The total time cost prior to optimization is approximately 87.1s (26.2s for efficient deployment and 60.9s for reduction), which is subsequently diminished by roughly 58.3% following the implementation of streamlined protocols. Notably, the reduction phase, though dominant at 60.9s (69.92%), has stabilized rather than declined sharply, suggesting diminishing returns in further optimization efforts. Conversely, the efficient deployment segment, accounting for 26.2s (30.08%), has consistently surpassed initial projections, indicating untapped potential for additional time savings in this category.
